name: session-id-validation
prompt: Session ids flow straight from query parameters into the store. Add validation at the STORE boundary: add func ValidSessionID(id string) bool in session.go returning true only when the id is 2 to 64 characters long and consists solely of ASCII letters, digits, and hyphens. Store.Get must return a new error ErrInvalidID (define it, wrapping nothing) when ValidSessionID(id) is false. Store.Create must refuse to store anything when ValidSessionID(id) is false (return the zero Session, no panic). Update main.go so POST and GET answer 400 Bad Request for invalid ids. Empty and short ids are invalid too, so the existing missing-param 400 stays consistent.
